name: app/empty-state
title: EmptyState
summary: A calm, centred card for "nothing here yet": a heading, one or two lines of help, and the next steps.

props.name: message
props.description: One or two lines of help.

props.name: icon
props.description: A small icon well above the title.

props.name: level
props.description: Heading level, so it sits in the page outline.

slots.name: default
slots.description: The next steps: a secondary and a primary action.

behaviour: The title is a real heading at `level`.
No illustration; actions render only when given.

theming.brandOverlay: None of its own; a primary action Button follows `--primary`.

noJs.without: Everything: the component is server-rendered HTML with no script.

responsive: Text is capped at the prose measure; actions wrap and centre.
contract:
contract
  slot is "empty-state"
  when default shows h2 "No agents yet"
  when h3 shows h3 "Nothing"
end

checks.say: No actions slot, no action row.
